history.note: teacher +400 (corrected safety model) then its criteria exposed as features
safety model + fold threshold tuned to 2.5 (teacher itself reaches +743)

Two epochs at lr 5e-5 on 900k teacher labels restricted to own-turn discards at 2+ shanten, from ck-best. Seed-matched margin over ck-best: +236 (4242), +199 (5150), +145 (31337); head-to-head vs ck-best -13.

737-dim features (exposed teacher ranking) raised fidelity 0.849->0.969 and the v2 margin from -587 to about -216 (3 replicas); a DAgger dose on the student's own states then reached roughly parity with the teacher (+22 / -126 / -24 across three runs).

Three runs measured +46/-1/+55 against efficiency-v2 at 4800 games, which looked like +300 -- but the baseline had only been measured once at that protocol. Re-measured at 9600 games (two seeds) the two models are indistinguishable (-31 vs -48), so the gain was noise. Not promoted.

Same recipe, same data volume, same teacher labels; only the encoder's danger block differs. Arm A (open threats on, no sequence read) measured -98.7 against v2; arm B (open threats off + sequence read) +99.8. The teacher itself gained +136 from the same read, so this is the first hand-written criterion to travel through the ladder.

history.recipe: from-scratch 900k x 4 epochs, lr 3e-4 (median of three replicas)
history.note: Group mean of this recipe is +271.5 against the stronger yardstick over three replicas (sd 65). The round-22 sequence-read feature change was refuted by a properly powered A/B this round: old block +271.5 vs new block +204.2, i.e. the change is slightly negative, not the +198 a single run suggested.

rebased_note: Acceptance now measured against the stronger rule bot; the frozen v1 baseline is kept as a guard so a candidate cannot buy v2 points by losing v1 points.
note: Acceptance is now measured *directly against the incumbent* (round 30): both play the same deals in the same games, so one evaluation replaces the incumbent's re-measurement plus the candidate's yardstick run, and `best_score` is in 'margin over the incumbent' units (the incumbent is 0). The rule-bot league is still measured as a guard whenever a candidate is about to be promoted, and the absolute anchor (margin against `--primary-spec`) is refreshed every 5 iterations into `absolute_anchor` / `best_absolute`.
